help_admins: Admin Commands: /pause: Pause the ongoing stream. /resume: Resume the paused stream. /skip: Skip the current stream. /stop: Stop the ongoing stream. /seek [duration in seconds]: Seek in the ongoing stream. /seekback [duration in seconds]: Seek backward in the ongoing stream. /reload: Reload admin cache.
help_auth: Auth Commands: Authorized users can control the ongoing stream without being admins. /auth: Add a user to the authorized users list. /unauth: Remove a user from the authorized users list.
help_blist: Blacklist Commands: Blacklisted chats and users cannot use the bot. /blacklist [chat_id|user_id]: Add a chat/user to blacklist. /unblacklist [chat_id|user_id]: Remove a chat/user from blacklist.
help_lang: Admin & Settings Commands: • /settings : Settings • /lang : Change system language • /auth : Authorize user • /unauth : Unauthorize user • /authlist : Authorized list • /reload : Refresh admin list • /start : Start tasks • /help : Help • /ping : Check speed • /stats : View data • /tr promote : Advertise bot • /groups : Fetch bot groups • /users : Fetch bot users • /bot - bot : Check bot • /ass - assistant : Check assistant account • /dev - developer : Call bot developer • /kim - kim : Call system programmer • /time - time : Fetch system time • /System - source : Check OS • Some settings available in developer keyboard
help_play: Play Commands in Group & Channel: • /play : Play video/audio • /stop : Stop • /pause : Pause • /resume : Resume • /skip : Skip • /loop : Loop, repeat • /seek : Rewind/forward • /playlist : Playlist • /queue : Queue
help_sudo: Control Panel Commands (For Dev): · System - Source control panel · Lock & Unlock - Global lock management · Broadcast - Broadcast panel · Assistant - Assistant control panel · Bot - Bot control panel · Contact & Stats - Contact and statistics panel · Backup - Backup panel · Force Subscribe - Force subscription panel • More commands to explore yourself
